item.title: Oil prices up as Iran says it will expand control over Strait of Hormuz
item.description: A top Iranian official says Tehran will impose an "exclusion zone" outside the Strait of Hormuz as it seeks to tighten its chokehold on tanker traffic.

item.title: Amazon cargo plane crash victims were in vehicles that were hit, NTSB says
item.description: An Amazon cargo plane overshot a runway at Miami International Airport and crashed into two vehicles before coming to a stop and bursting into flames. Five people were killed.

item.title: 3 American men advance to U.S. Open quarterfinals
item.description: The U.S. Open still has several Americans in action as we head into the second week at Flushing Meadows. Yahoo Sports senior writer Dan Wolken joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: NTSB arrives at MIA to begin investigation into deadly plane crash
item.description: An Amazon cargo plane overran a runway at Miami International Airport and struck several vehicles, killing at least five people and injuring five others, officials said.

item.title: Fall television season set to begin
item.description: Labor Day weekend not only marks the traditional end of summer, but the start of the fall television season. The Hollywood Reporter senior editor Alex Weprin joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Previewing New Hampshire's Senate primaries
item.description: Primary voters in New Hampshire are heading to the polls on Tuesday, where the balance of power in the U.S. Senate may be at stake. CBS News congressional reporter Taurean Small has the details.

item.title: Ross Fire still burning, with over 90,000 acres scorched
item.description: The wildfire, which has torn through Palo Pinto and Jack counties, forced evacuations, closed roads and disrupted schools.

item.title: Canada's retaliatory tariffs set to take effect at midnight
item.description: Canada's latest retaliatory tariffs against the U.S. are set to take effect overnight Monday into Tuesday. CBS News business contributor Javier David joins to discuss how your finances could be impacted.

item.title: Hurricane warning issued for western Hawaii as Lowell approaches
item.description: The National Hurricane Center posted a hurricane warning for western Hawaii's Kauai County as Hurricane Lowell moved toward the area as a Category 2 storm.

item.title: Tehran threatens attacks after U.S. strikes Iranian tankers
item.description: Iran is threatening retaliation after U.S. airstrikes sank three ships in the Gulf. CBS News homeland security correspondent Nicole Sganga reports.

item.title: Hurricane Lowell expected to impact Hawaii overnight
item.description: Hurricane Lowell has turned northward and is expected to pass close to Hawaii overnight Monday into Tuesday, bringing hurricane-force winds and heavy rainfall. CBS News correspondent Carter Evans reports from Kauai.

item.title: NTSB gives update on deadly Amazon cargo plane crash
item.description: The National Transportation Safety Board held a news conference on Monday, one day after an Amazon cargo plane overran a runway and crashed at Miami International Airport. Officials said they recovered the flight data and cockpit voice recorders, but the cause remains unknown.

item.title: Mexican Independence Day parade postponed in New Jersey due to surge in ICE arrests
item.description: For more than three decades, the Mexican Day parade in Passaic has been one of New Jersey's largest celebrations of Mexican culture. But this year, a surge in ICE arrests has prompted organizers to postpone the event indefinitely. CBS News New York reporter Nick Caloway has the details.

item.title: Beef prices hit record highs with cattle herds at historic lows
item.description: Beef prices are hitting record highs, and America's cattle supply is shrinking. Ranchers are dealing with drought, high costs and smaller herds. CBS News correspondent Ian Lee is in Wyoming with more.

item.title: Trump administration makes 3rd Supreme Court appeal to allow mail ballot restrictions
item.description: The Trump administration is making a third emergency appeal to the Supreme Court in hopes of reinstating new mail ballot restrictions ahead of November's midterm elections. CBS News legal contributor Jessica Levinson has more.

item.title: Drought, rising costs and beef import pressures squeeze Wyoming ranchers
item.description: "It's been a year that I hope we never do it again," said Lander Nicodemus, owner of Torrington Livestock Markets, which auctions about 450,000 head of cattle each year.

item.title: Pope Leo unveils new fresco at sanctuary where he prayed after his election
item.description: Pope Leo XIV unveiled the portrait before celebrating Mass with his fellow Augustinian brothers at the Sanctuary of Our Mother of Good Counsel​ in the medieval village of Genazzano, south of Rome.

item.title: Hawaii braces for impacts of Hurricane Lowell
item.description: Hurricane Lowell is forecast to pass by the Hawaiian Islands and residents are bracing for the heavy rains and storms that could follow. CBS News' Carter Evans has the latest.

item.title: Far-right party win in Germany shocks Merz
item.description: Far-right party AfD shocked German Chancellor Friedrich Merz with a landslide regional election victory. CBS News' Trevor Phillips has more.

item.title: Gas prices at record high for any Labor Day, as diesel hits all-time record
item.description: The average price of regular gas was $4.15 a gallon on Labor Day, well above the Labor Day weekend record of $3.82 from 2012, and diesel was at a new all-time record of $5.90.

item.title: Taliban uses American weapons and equipment to retain control in Afghanistan
item.description: The Taliban remains in control of Afghanistan, using American weapons and gear that were left there after the U.S. pulled out in 2021.

item.title: Lithuanian citizens mobilize for possible Russian aggression
item.description: Lithuanian citizens are mobilizing against potential Russian aggression as the U.S. special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner held talks in Moscow and Kyiv. CBS News national security analyst Aaron MacLean has more.

item.title: Kushner attributes the lack of progress on Gaza to upcoming Israeli elections
item.description: U.S. efforts to advance plans​ to disarm Hamas and open the way for investment into rebuilding Gaza have stalled.

item.title: Details emerge on deadly Amazon cargo plane crash
item.description: More details are emerging on the Amazon cargo plane crash near the Miami International Airport that left five people dead and more injured. CBS News' Skyler Henry has the latest.

item.title: King says Prince Harry and Meghan remain private citizens after U.K. return
item.description: Prince Harry and Meghan stepped down as senior working members of the royal family in January 2020, and this position, the letter said, "will continue to be fully respected."

item.title: Witness says seeing Amazon plane crash at MIA was "something from a movie"
item.description: Five people were killed and five others were injured when a plane overshot a runway at Miami International Airport and crashed.

item.title: 25 years after 9/11, Taliban rules Afghanistan again, but with U.S. firepower
item.description: CBS News finds Taliban forces patrolling Kabul in American armored vehicles, wearing American tactical gear and carrying American weapons.

item.title: Drone activity at border drops 75% after U.S. uses laser weapon, military says
item.description: In less than two weeks, the high-energy laser weapon system has taken down 11 drones, coinciding with a 75% drop in drones probing the border, military officials told CBS News.

item.title: What's open and closed on Labor Day 2026? See which businesses are operating.
item.description: Most major retail stores and grocery chains will remain open on Labor Day, while banks will close.

item.title: 9/6: Face The Nation
item.description: This week on "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan," with midterm elections less than two months away, Michigan Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson joins as well as Reps. Jason Crow and Lisa McClain. Plus, Sunoco chairman and Republican midterm convention chair Ray Washburne joins.
